launch.banner.headline: Everything was already in place, so {gameName} is starting now
launch.checking.title: Checking your files…
launch.checks.clean: No new changes in your game files or saves
launch.checks.cleanInstall: No new changes in your game files
launch.checks.install: Game version and mods: already on {state}
launch.checks.installPlain: Game version and mods: already match this profile
launch.checks.title: What SavePoint checked
launch.dialog.discardMessage: {role, select, install {The game install folder} external {The saves folder} other {The folder}} ({path}) goes back to its last snapshot.{role, select, external { Progress you saved in the game since then is lost.} other {}}

launch.dialog.olderPointSwitch: This is an older snapshot of "{profileName}". You can keep later changes in your game folders as a new profile.
launch.dialog.saveCaption: This replaces what's in your saves folder now.
launch.dialog.savingFirst: Taking a snapshot of these changes…

launch.dialog.saveSubtitle: {count, plural, one {# save snapshot} other {# save snapshots}} to choose from
launch.dialog.saveSubtitleRecent: Latest · {count, plural, one {# save snapshot} other {# save snapshots}} to choose from

launch.dialog.title: Switch to "{profileName}"?
launch.dialog.unfinishedBody: {role, select, install {The game install folder} external {The saves folder} other {A folder}} has files from two snapshots. Finish the switch, or discard the mix to go back to where it started.
launch.dialog.unsavedBody: {count, plural, one {{countText} file} other {{countText} files}} in {role, select, install {the game's folder} external {your saves folder} other {this folder}} changed since the last snapshot of "{ownerName}". Take a snapshot to keep them there, or discard them.
launch.dialog.unsavedBodyUnowned: {count, plural, one {{countText} file} other {{countText} files}} in {role, select, install {the game's folder} external {your saves folder} other {this folder}} changed since the last snapshot. Keep them as a new profile, or discard them.
launch.dialog.unsavedTitle: New changes since the last snapshot
launch.dialog.versionReplaced: About {size} of files will be replaced.
launch.dialog.versionRemoved: About {size} of files will be removed.
launch.dialog.versionSentence: Going from {from}, {direction, select, back {back to} other {to}} {target}.
launch.failure.heldBody: Something else is holding one of the game's files open. Close the game, its launcher and any mod manager, then try again.
launch.failure.heldTitle: A file is in use, so the switch didn't start
launch.keep.body: SavePoint takes a snapshot of your game folders as they are now and makes it a new profile.
launch.keep.partial: Only part of that was kept. {reason} Your changes are still in your game folders. Try again, or discard them.
launch.keep.title: Keep as a new profile
launch.keptAsNew.body: {folder, select, install {Your game version and mods} external {Your saves} other {Your game folders}} didn't end with the snapshot you chose to replace, so this session was added as a new snapshot instead. The others are unchanged.
launch.keptAsNew.title: Kept as a new snapshot
launch.leftAlone.body: {folder, select, install {Your game version and mods weren't} external {Your saves weren't} other {Your game folders weren't}} included, because you played them from another profile's snapshot. Their changes stay in your game folders, and SavePoint asks about them next time you play.
launch.leftAlone.title: Part of that session isn't in the snapshot
launch.partial.body: {saved, select, install {Your game version and mods are in the snapshot. Your saves aren't yet.} external {Your saves are in the snapshot. Your game version and mods aren't yet.} other {Part of your session is in the snapshot.}} {reason} Your game folders are unchanged. Fix that, then retry that part.

Your game folders are unchanged. Fix that, then retry that part.

launch.postPlay.choicesLabel: What to do with this session
launch.postPlay.failedAtStart.hint: The program you chose closed right away with an error (code {code}), so the game didn't start. If the game is in your Steam library, set it to start Through Steam in Edit game instead.
launch.postPlay.failedAtStart.title: The program closed right away
launch.postPlay.failedAtStart.toast: The program for {gameName} closed right away with an error (code {code}). Try Through Steam in Edit game.
launch.postPlay.fork.sub: Recommended. "{profileName}" and its newer snapshots stay as they are.
launch.postPlay.fork.title: Keep this session as a new profile
launch.postPlay.installChanged: {count, plural, one {{countText} file} other {{countText} files}} in the game's own folder also changed, as an update would.
launch.postPlay.leaveOut: Leave these out from now on
launch.postPlay.leaveOutDone: Done. You can change this under "Files to leave out of the game's own folder" in Edit game.
launch.postPlay.leaveOutFailed: SavePoint couldn't leave those files out from now on. {reason}
launch.postPlay.move.sub: This session becomes the latest snapshot of "{profileName}". {count, plural, =0 {Nothing is removed.} one {# newer snapshot moves to Recently removed.} other {# newer snapshots move to Recently removed.}}
launch.postPlay.move.title: Continue "{profileName}" from this session
launch.postPlay.moveConfirm.message: {count, plural, one {# newer snapshot is} other {# newer snapshots are}} removed from "{profileName}" and kept in Recently removed until you next free up space. Until then you can bring {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} back as a new profile. After that, {count, plural, one {it is} other {they are}} deleted for good.
launch.postPlay.moveConfirm.title: Continue "{profileName}" from this session?
launch.postPlay.neverMatched.hint: The program name in Edit game never showed up as running, so SavePoint went by when the program it started closed. If that's wrong, check the name.
launch.postPlay.neverMatched.toast: The program name for {gameName} never showed up as running. Check it in Edit game.
launch.postPlay.new.sub: Recommended. Your earlier snapshots stay as they are.
launch.postPlay.new.subOptional: Your earlier snapshots stay as they are.
launch.postPlay.new.title: Keep this session as a new snapshot
launch.postPlay.notSeen.hint: The program name from Edit game never showed up as running in two minutes, so SavePoint can't tell how long you played. The name may be wrong, or the game started slowly.
launch.postPlay.notSeen.title: SavePoint didn't see the game running
launch.postPlay.notSeen.toast: SavePoint didn't see {gameName} running. If it did run, check the program name in Edit game.
launch.postPlay.olderNote: You played from an older snapshot of "{profileName}", so this session can't go on the end of it.
launch.postPlay.runTimeOnly: {count, plural, one {{countText} file in the game's own folder changed. It's a log or crash report, not an update.} other {{countText} files in the game's own folder changed. They're logs or crash reports, not an update.}}
launch.postPlay.skip.sub: Your saves stay in your game folders as new changes. SavePoint asks again before you switch profiles.
launch.postPlay.skip.subNothingChanged: Recommended. Nothing changed, so there is nothing new to keep.
launch.postPlay.skip.title: Not now
launch.postPlay.title: You played for {duration}
launch.postPlay.unreadable.hint: SavePoint couldn't check which programs were running, so it doesn't know when the game closed.
launch.postPlay.unreadable.title: SavePoint couldn't tell how long you played
launch.postPlay.update.sub: What "{pointName}" held before moves to Recently removed.
launch.postPlay.update.title: Replace "{pointName}" with this session
launch.postPlay.updateConfirm.message: "{pointName}" will hold this session instead. What it held before is kept in Recently removed until you next free up space. Until then you can bring it back as a new profile. After that, it is deleted for good.
launch.postPlay.updateConfirm.title: Replace this snapshot?
